title: Junta Launches Four-Column Counteroffensive to Retake Zinbon Outpost Near Shwegu
detail: Beginning August 31, 2026, the junta launched a counteroffensive to retake the Zinbon-area outpost it lost to the KIA-KPDF coalition the day before, deploying four ground columns of roughly 200 troops each — three east of the Ayeyarwady River and one near Thingaw In on the western side — backed by continuous airstrikes. Clashes raged along the Tawlan and Zinbon mountain ranges as fighting spread across the Shwegu-Sinkhan corridor. The offensive is tied to the junta's broader effort to reopen the Shwegu-Sinkhan road and clear the Irrawaddy River route for its stalled Mandalay-Bhamo resupply flotilla.

media.caption: Junta forces mounted a four-column counteroffensive with continuous airstrikes near Zinbon, Shwegu Township.
